Generate sea-level rise and tidal inundation scenarios

Source: R/generateFullTidalScenario.R
generateFullTidalScenario.Rd

Queries one or more NOAA tide gauges and generates annual sea-level and tidal inundation scenarios for each gauge.

Usage

generateFullTidalScenario(
  station_id = 9410660,
  run_hindcast = TRUE,
  run_forecast = TRUE,
  hindcast_start = 1928,
  forecast_start = 2026,
  forecast_end = 2100,
  scenario = c("ssp126", "ssp245"),
  confidence_level = "medium",
  target_quantile = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),
  include_lt_tidal_const = TRUE,
  datum_start_year = 1980,
  datum_end_year = 2025
)

Arguments

station_id

Vector of NOAA station identifiers.

run_hindcast

Logical. Generate historical sea-level data.

run_forecast

Logical. Generate forecast sea-level scenarios.

hindcast_start

First year of hindcast.

forecast_start

First year of forecast.

forecast_end

Final forecast year.

scenario

Character vector of AR6 scenarios.

confidence_level

Character vector of confidence levels.

target_quantile

Numeric vector of target quantiles.

include_lt_tidal_const

Include long-term tidal constituents.

datum_start_year

First year used to calculate tidal datums.

datum_end_year

Last year used to calculate tidal datums.

Value

A list containing:

  • scenario_curves: Combined scenario table for all gauges.

  • tidal_datums_summarized: Combined tidal datum table for all gauges.
